items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: So I worked there at the Dreamland with him and then tell the truth, we come on down there and played dances

ctx.x: And this Cliff Jones, we call him Snag, he come up one day to my house and told me that Tiny Paar sent him to get me to play with him. So I went on down and made rehearsal with him and went through okay. So I went there at the Dreamland with him and then tell the truth, we come on down there and played dances. You know all in stuff.

Well, Tiny Palm was at the Dreamland and this Cliff Jones, we call him Snag, he come up one day to my house and told me that Tiny Palm sent him to get me to play with him. So I went on down and made rehearsal with him and went through okay. So I worked there at the Dreamland with him and then tell the truth, we come on down there and played dances, you know all these. Yeah, middle trip, all the way, you know, tour.
That's the State Street, the Dreamland on State Street.

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: me and Cliff Jones on drums

ctx.x: Uh-huh. At the Dreamland, huh? Who was in the band?
Well, I don't know, me and Cliff Jones on drums, and some other guys, I can't remember them fellas now. Been a good while, you know.
Was this the same band that made the recordings?
